section 10.info: The word 'woman' denotes a female human being of any age, including a girl child.
section 10.punishment: No punishment; this section is definitional.

section 304B.info: Death of a woman caused by burns, bodily injury, or abnormal circumstances within seven years of marriage linked to dowry cruelty or harassment.
section 304B.punishment: Imprisonment for not less than seven years, may extend to life imprisonment; fine may also be imposed.

section 312.info: Punishes voluntarily causing a woman with child to miscarry, unless done in good faith to save the woman's life.
section 312.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years, or fine, or both.

section 313.info: Punishment for causing a miscarriage without the woman's consent.
section 313.punishment: Imprisonment up to seven years, and fine.

section 314.main_keywords: Death caused by intent to cause miscarriage
section 314.info: Punishes any act done with intent to cause miscarriage that results in the woman's death.
section 314.punishment: Imprisonment for life or up to ten years; fine may also be imposed.

section 317.info: Punishes exposing or abandoning a child under twelve years of age.
section 317.punishment: Imprisonment up to seven years, and fine.

section 354.info: Punishes assault or criminal force on any woman intending to outrage her modesty.
section 354.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years, or fine, or both.

section 354A.info: Defines sexual harassment as unwelcome physical contact, demands for sexual favors, or showing pornography against a woman's will.
section 354A.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years and fine; for sexual harassment by repeated actions, imprisonment up to five years and fine.

section 354B.info: Punishes use of assault or criminal force on a woman with intent to disrobe or compel her to be naked.
section 354B.punishment: Imprisonment from three to seven years, and fine.

section 354C.info: Punishes watching or capturing images of a woman engaged in a private act where she would expect privacy.
section 354C.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years, and fine; repeat offense up to five years.

section 354D.info: Punishes following a woman or contacting her repeatedly despite her clear disinterest, including electronic communication.
section 354D.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years, and fine; if in combination with sexual intent, up to five years.

section 361.info: Defines kidnapping from lawful guardianship of a female under eighteen years of age.
section 361.punishment: Imprisonment up to seven years, and fine; if for ransom, up to ten years.

section 366.info: Relates to kidnapping or abducting a woman to compel her marriage against her will or force into illicit intercourse.
section 366.punishment: Imprisonment up to ten years, and fine.

section 366A.info: Punishes inducing a girl under eighteen to go from any place with intent she be forced or seduced into illicit intercourse.
section 366A.punishment: Imprisonment from ten years to life, and fine.

section 366B.info: Punishes importing a girl under twenty-one years into India with intent to force or seduce her into illicit intercourse.
section 366B.punishment: Imprisonment from seven years to life, and fine.

section 370.info: Defines and punishes trafficking for exploitation, including physical/sexual exploitation, slavery, or removal of organs.
section 370.punishment: Imprisonment from seven years to life; fine included.

section 372.info: Prohibits selling, letting to hire, or otherwise disposing of any person under eighteen years for prostitution or illicit intercourse.
section 372.punishment: Imprisonment from seven years to life, and fine.

section 373.info: Prohibits buying, hiring or obtaining possession of any person under eighteen years to be used for prostitution or illicit intercourse.
section 373.punishment: Imprisonment from seven years to life, and fine.

section 375.info: Defines the offense of rape, including non-consensual sexual acts and consent obtained through fear or deception.
section 375.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment from seven to ten years; in aggravating circumstances, life imprisonment or death may apply.

section 376.info: Provides punishment for rape and special provisions for offenders in authority or positions of trust.
section 376.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment from ten years to life; fine may be imposed.

section 376A.info: Punishes rape causing the woman’s death or persistent vegetative state.
section 376A.punishment: Imprisonment for life or death penalty.

section 376B.info: Punishes sexual intercourse by a man with his wife (without her consent) while they are living separately.
section 376B.punishment: Imprisonment up to two years, and fine.

section 376C.info: Punishes sexual intercourse by a person in authority over a woman in custody who induces her to have intercourse.
section 376C.punishment: Imprisonment from five to ten years, and fine.

section 376AB.info: Punishes rape of a woman under twelve years with rigorous imprisonment (not less than twenty years) or death.
section 376AB.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment twenty years to death; fine applicable.

section 376D.info: Addresses gang rape, where a woman is raped by one or more persons acting together.
section 376D.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment from twenty years to life, and fine.

section 376DA.main_keywords: Gang rape on girl under sixteen
section 376DA.info: Provides severe punishment for gang rape against a girl under sixteen years.
section 376DA.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment from twenty years to life; death may be imposed.

section 376DB.info: Mandates severe punishment for gang rape of a woman under twelve years, including life imprisonment or death.
section 376DB.punishment: Life imprisonment or death; fine applicable.

section 376E.info: Provides enhanced punishment for persons previously convicted of sexual offenses who commit them again.
section 376E.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment from twenty years to life; death may apply.

section 326A.info: Punishes throwing acid or attempting to cause permanent/partial damage, deformity, or disfigurement by acid attack with imprisonment not less than ten years and fine.
section 326A.punishment: Imprisonment ten years to life, and fine.

section 326B.info: Punishes attempting an acid attack with imprisonment not less than five years and up to seven years, plus fine.
section 326B.punishment: Imprisonment five to seven years, and fine.

section 228A.info: Prevents disclosure of identity of a victim of sexual offences to avoid social victimization.
section 228A.punishment: Imprisonment up to two years, and fine.

section 493.info: Punishes a man who deceitfully induces a woman to believe she is lawfully married to him to have sexual intercourse.
section 493.punishment: Imprisonment up to ten years, and fine.

section 498A.info: Punishes a husband or his relatives for subjecting a woman to cruelty, including conduct likely to drive her to suicide or cause grave injury.
section 498A.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years, and fine.

section 509.info: Punishes words, gestures, or acts intended to insult the modesty of a woman or intrude upon her privacy.
section 509.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years, and fine.

section 354E.info: Punishes harassment of a woman through electronic means or social media with intent to disturb or outrage her modesty.
section 354E.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years, and fine.

section 354F.info: Punishes voyeurism or sexual harassment of women in public or semi-public places using technology or physical approach.
section 354F.punishment: Imprisonment up to three years, and fine.

act Protection of Women from Domestic Vi.info: Provides remedies/protection against domestic violence, including physical, sexual, emotional, verbal, and economic abuse.
act Protection of Women from Domestic Vi.punishment: Protection orders, residence orders, monetary relief; criminal penalties for violation up to three years imprisonment or fine.

act Sexual Harassment of Women at Workpl.info: Provides protection against sexual harassment of women at workplaces with redressal mechanism and internal complaints committees.
act Sexual Harassment of Women at Workpl.punishment: Penalty for non-compliance by employer: fine up to 50,000 INR; offender may face disciplinary or criminal action.
